note: City of Stephen municipal campground beside the pool, golf course, curling club and school playground on the west edge of town. Harvest crews may fill it from August to October. --Claude
summary: City page read: 27 sites with water, electric, sewer and cable TV, Wi-Fi, shower/laundry building; $25 a night / $150 week / $350 month (fees re-confirmed, note rewritten); phone reservations at the City Office. Season not posted. Google 4.5 (19). Long-stay tests pass with a harvest-season caveat. Pin OK; not waterfront kept.
flags: Long-stay tests (weekly/monthly marketed): (1) the city leads with family recreation, not long stays; (2) a nightly rate is posted on the operator's own page ($25 a night); (3) sites are RV/tent pads, no homes or park models; (4) no booking engine to run an occupancy check - imagery (autumn) shows ~20 RVs on the 27 sites; (5) nothing sold or leased beyond month contracts. Reviews read: 3 weeks ago 'Great campground perfect for big rigs. $25 a night. May be booked from Aug-Oct for the beet harvest. 30/50 amp fhu.'; a year ago '$23 daily rate based on a two-week stay, weekly rate ... a quiet, safe place to sleep and use as sightseeing basecamp'; a year ago '... after a 14 hr work day ...'. Read: a city RV campground with travellers most of the season and sugar-beet harvest crews in late summer and fall - not mostly seasonal. Pass, with the harvest caveat in the note.
Google Maps 4.5 from 19 reviews; one 4-month-old review complains about a city office worker.
Hookups: the city page lists water, electricity and sewer hookups but no amperage; a 3-week-old Google review says '30/50 amp fhu'. hookups.electric left unset (no operator source for the amps).
Season: not written. The city page posts no dates; nothing read says whether the campground stays open in winter.
Waterfront: keep not waterfront. On imagery the loop sits in open ground between shelterbelts on the north-west edge of town, next to the curling club; no water body near.
Pin 48.45170,-96.88170 is on the campground loop's south row (Google place 48.45193,-96.88110, ~50 m): OK.
Phone 218-478-3614 (City Office) and website https://stephenmn.com/pages/recreation confirmed.
